name: Eternal Hall (7-8) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
description: Time distorts along this hallway, making the air feel like sludge.
disable: DC 27 Thievery (trained) to disrupt the temporal distortions, or Dispel Magic (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to disperse the temporal energy

generalAbilities.name: Time Press
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the hall

Effect Time weighs upon the creature, dealing (4d10+18) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save). On a critical failure, the creature is Slowed 1 for 4 rounds.
